candidates.title: BERxiT: Early Exiting for BERT with Better Fine-Tuning and Extension to Regression
candidates.venue: Conference of the European Chapter of the Association for Computational Linguistics
candidates.abstract: The slow speed of BERT has motivated much research on accelerating its inference, and the early exiting idea has been proposed to make trade-offs between model quality and efficiency. This paper aims to address two weaknesses of previous work: (1) existing fine-tuning strategies for early exiting models fail to take full advantage of BERT; (2) methods to make exiting decisions are limited to classification tasks. We propose a more advanced fine-tuning strategy and a learning-to-exit module that extends early exiting to tasks other than classification. Experiments demonstrate improved early exiting for BERT, with better trade-offs obtained by the proposed fine-tuning strategy, successful application to regression tasks, and the possibility to combine it with other acceleration methods. Source code can be found at https://github.com/castorini/berxit.
candidates.reason: BERTの各層にexit判断を設け、容易な入力は後段層を実行せず推論計算を削減するearly-exit方式。classificationだけでなくregressionへLearning-to-Exitを拡張し、実推論時間削減を評価するため直接対象。
candidates.library_body_check: fulltext_relevance_review: ACL一次論文と本文結果を確認。Alternating fine-tuningでfinal classifierとintermediate exitsの干渉を抑え、LTE moduleがclassification/regression双方のexitを学習。GLUE/STSB等で品質を維持しつつ大幅なinference computation/time削減を示し、他のcompressionとも累積可能。
